claim_updates.reason: Neither advanced nor falsified; the effective registry ceiling is unchanged at EXPERIMENTAL (codex/claim_state.json latest_event_by_claim C-PARAM-INHERIT = EXP-PRODUCT-36249064252, status EXPERIMENTAL), and this is a retention event recording that the packet's identifying gate was not validly executed, not a downgrade of the mechanism. Grounds, all in this packet: (1) The pre-declared falsifier's own precondition was not met. prereg.md section 10 conditions FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING on 'positive control passes AND null control passes'; both failed (audit.json baseline_findings PC-SAME-RESOURCE status=FAIL with observed success_rate 0.0 against the preregistered >=0.95, and NC-SHUFFLED-INTENT status=FAIL with observed mechanisms_induced=6). result.json outcome=FALSIFIES and report.md sections 1/6/7 therefore exceed the frozen prereg, and the producer's own two outputs disagree: report.md section 3.2 labels NC-SHUFFLED-INTENT PASS while result.json.controls labels it FAIL. The record stands; the inference does not follow. (2) The treatment's zero success is attributable to a defect in committed product code, which I verified by static reading of the exact artifact the audit cites and which audit.validity_findings[0] and result.json.observations[13] both name: src/spider/kernel.py _build_action_template (lines 316-356) overwrites the entire value at a varying field path with the slot placeholder -- its two branches at lines 344-347 are behaviorally identical, so '/api/v1/items/item-42' becomes '${id}' with no URL prefix retained -- while the module's own _strip_common_prefix helper (line 258) is defined and never called anywhere in the file. This is a product-code defect, not a harness artifact. (3) The headline economics is not a measurement of inheritance. treatment_transfer_cost_per_task=1.0 is the success-path cost, and run_experiment.py lines 337-361 set resolved=True and skip the cold fallback as soon as resolution.status==EXECUTABLE, so an arm that issued one invalid request and achieved nothing is charged one request per task; audit.validity_findings[9] says the same and audit.recomputed_metrics records the fallback-consistent ratio as 'infinite'. amortized_cost_ratio_vs_best_baseline=13.666666666666666 and break_even_transfer_tasks=null are therefore artifacts of pairing a success-path cost with a zero-success outcome and must not be read as evidence about amortization. (4) Power and controls are below preregistration: treatment_n_transfer_tasks=30 total, 10 per family (run_experiment.py line 317, RESOURCE_B_IDS[:30]) against spec.json falsifier n>=50 per family and >=150 total; no family-stratified B=5000 bootstrap (result.json.validity_notes[12]); n_negative_probes=8 against the preregistered 60 per arm. (5) The safety and calibration numbers are degenerate rather than positive. Because no treatment resolution ever produced a successful outcome, false_accept_rate=0.0 and abstention_precision=1.0 are guaranteed by the arm being inert, ece_treatment=0.0 is a single-bin quantity (result.json.validity_notes[13]), and treatment_binding_accuracy=0.0 is a division-by-zero artifact of zero successes rather than a measured binding failure rate (run_experiment.py line 379). These three numbers re-derive inertness and do not probe the out-of-support-slot failure direction the packet existed to test. (6) The substrate's cost dynamic range is configured, not measured. B-COLD is a fixed 3-request-per-task harness policy (run_experiment.py lines 211-234, audit.validity_findings[7]), so the amortization denominator is a constant, and induction_cost=1200 is an estimate computed as len(observations)*15 (run_experiment.py line 508) rather than counted from the observation-collection requests. (7) Provenance digests do not all verify: result.json.artifacts claims f2e3d4c5b6a7 for src/spider/__init__.py (actual da010bfd32cd3f446d6a34c52e2a284c76adee8196983dafbb9a9a7cedd6bd04) and a1b2c3d4e5f6 for run_experiment.py (actual 90d46b1683595c8d8ee0caedea959b49d77ac118d672caf75d9101fe28221277), both placeholders, and its tests/test_kernel.py digest e3896a26023159f41db10073dbc714be769f4... carries a one-character typo against the actual e3896a26023159f41db10073dbc714be7769f4...; provenance.json.frozen_inputs.freeze.json records the placeholder 3f0f9d6d7a8b9c0d... against the actual b879e1f057d5638c1cd8caa837141e23c1a67705028720883b093b4cf5cb03c8. The three inputs freeze.json actually pins (request.json, spec.json, prereg.md) verify exactly, and src/spider/kernel.py c7b818eb... and substrate.py d3fe358e... verify, so the packet is not wholesale untrustworthy -- but two of its artifact identities are not citable. What is established and bounded: the capability is present in the tree at this commit (src/spider/kernel.py sha256 c7b818eb555ef323e45549dc08d5d76a980bf1ecb8c338752439c20b9b167ddb defines align_parameters at line 437, distill_parameterized at line 556 and SpiderKernel.distill_parameterized at line 556; tests/test_kernel.py sha256 e3896a26023159f41db10073dbc714be7769f4fed0ba60690b174605e1a793a9 carries 13 references to distill_parameterized/align_parameters), and the path-prefix defect above is a verified static property of that committed code. That is commit-anchored code presence plus one code defect. It is not durability, not an economic result, and not a transfer result. C-PARAM-INHERIT's economic viability is now untested for a second consecutive cycle, but for a changed and more tractable reason: the capability under test is not executable as written, so the economic question has not yet been posed to the world.

Retention event, not an advance and not a new claim for this lane. C-MEAS-VALID is not a frozen claim_id of this packet (spec.json claim_ids = ['C-PARAM-INHERIT']) and is adjudicated here only because this packet supplies a second independent instance of exactly the failure the claim names -- registry next_gate 'writable/auth/session/drift controls must produce discriminating positive and null outcomes'. Its current status is already MEASUREMENT_INVALID (codex/claim_state.json latest_event_by_claim C-MEAS-VALID = EXP-RUNTIME-36106663091), and nothing here changes that; the new adverse evidence is recorded so the next designer does not treat a control set as discriminating by assumption. (1) The positive control does not discriminate: PC-SAME-RESOURCE recorded success_rate 0.0 against a preregistered >=0.95 (result.json.controls.PC-SAME-RESOURCE status=FAIL, audit.baseline_findings), and the audit attributes it to the same product-code path defect rather than to the induction concept (audit.validity_findings[2]). (2) The null control is affirmatively non-discriminating for the current implementation, and this is a bounded negative result about the control set rather than about inheritance economics: NC-SHUFFLED-INTENT induced 6 mechanisms from randomly permuted intent labels (result.json.controls.NC-SHUFFLED-INTENT.observed.mechanisms_induced=6, audit.validity_findings[3] severity major), so the induction path manufactures parameter slots with the intent structure destroyed. The parent's certified rejection of the spurious-matcher explanation (EXP-PRODUCT-36249064252 handoff carry_forward.rejected) therefore does not transfer to this implementation and must not be cited for it. (3) The control was additionally not evaluated against its preregistered criterion: prereg.md section 5.2 specifies success_rate <= 0.10, abstention_precision >= 0.90 and cost_ratio >= 1.0, while the recorded datum is an induced-mechanism count, which is a different quantity. (4) The substrate's own manipulation is unverified as a manipulation: B-COLD simulates discovery with a fixed 3-request policy instead of executing multi-step auth, pagination traversal and schema discovery per task (audit.validity_findings[7], severity moderate), so the arm the whole amortization comparison is measured against is a harness constant rather than a measured control.

product_action: Do not promote, and do not route any product surface through the parameterized path. promotion_ready is false here for three independent and mutually sufficient reasons, any one of which is decisive: (a) the pre-declared promotion rule in prereg.md section 11 is 'If PASS (all 9 conditions), then promote_to_product=true and C-PARAM-INHERIT->VALIDATED. If FAIL/MIXED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID, promote_to_product=false', and the gate did not pass -- spec.json decision_rule conditions 1, 5, 6, 7 and 8 all failed, so the rule's own text forces false and no post-hoc substitution is permitted; (b) audit.json status is REVISE with producer_claim_supported=false, and AGENTS.md plus research/EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md section 7 authorize promotion only for Product-lane code that survived the frozen gate and the independent audit; (c) the mechanical path is closed anyway, since .github/workflows/product-promote.yml line 74 exits 1 unless audit.json status == PASS. Retain the delta on the branch for the record and treat it as reverted: because this verdict must emit false, scripts/revert_product_reject.py will restore every path under the product allowed_code_roots (src, tests, sdk, pyproject.toml) to execution_checkpoint.json pre_execute_sha f98f232bafd450cd260a66fbd3d0ef2f494e22fe, which is currently 488 added lines in src/spider/kernel.py, 198 in tests/test_kernel.py and 2 in src/spider/__init__.py. That makes this the fourteenth structurally identical add-at-execute/delete-at-verdict cycle; the packet's stated goal of closing that pathology is not met and the audit.claim_ceiling sentence asserting the capability 'survives the promotion gate' is bounded down here, because the gate returned REVISE and no promotion was authorized. Two concrete code defects must be carried forward as open items rather than closed by assertion: (1) _build_action_template at src/spider/kernel.py lines 316-356 cannot preserve a URL prefix and _strip_common_prefix at line 258 is dead code, so no induced path template is currently executable; (2) the literal SpiderKernel.distill() path still hardcodes confidence 0.5 against min_confidence 0.8, recorded again here as incumbent_has_distill_parameterized=false. Add one process item: remediate the two placeholder digests in result.json.artifacts and the placeholder freeze.json digest in provenance.json.frozen_inputs, or require every future auditor to recompute them. The next product action is the corrected, executed-baseline measurement stated in next_question, which requires a new Global Research Director mandate because the kernel must change; promotion is to be re-adjudicated from that run, never inferred from this one.
next_question: On the committed product kernel, does a corrected _build_action_template that preserves the URL prefix (src/spider/kernel.py:316-356 currently overwrites the entire path value with the slot placeholder, and the module's own _strip_common_prefix at line 258 is defined but never called) let distill_parameterized execute bound mechanisms end-to-end on never-observed resource-B identifiers -- specifically, can PC-SAME-RESOURCE reach its preregistered success_rate >= 0.95 with a bound path of the form /api/v1/<collection>/<slot> -- and, with B-COLD re-measured by actually executing multi-step auth, pagination traversal and schema discovery per task instead of the current fixed 3-request harness policy, does that executable mechanism then reach amortized_cost_ratio <= 0.85 against B-COLD, B-LITERAL-REPLAY and B-RETRIEVAL-K5 at matched end-to-end success and break even at or before an N_MAX derived before freeze from that executed baseline cost, at the preregistered n >= 50 per family with the family-stratified B=5000 bootstrap and 60 negative probes per arm, with NC-SHUFFLED-INTENT re-evaluated against its preregistered transfer-success criterion rather than its induced-mechanism count?
reason: The transaction ran and the substrate was real, but the packet did not measure the proposition it was frozen to measure, and the independent audit reached that conclusion independently (audit.json status=REVISE, producer_claim_supported=false, eight required_fixes, claim_ceiling explicitly declining to test the economic hypothesis on a valid implementation). I bound that further in three directions. First, the falsifier is not merely unsupported, it is unmet on its own terms: prereg.md section 10 requires both controls to pass before FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING, and both failed, so the producer's outcome=FALSIFIES does not identify the architecture-pivot conclusion it was attached to. Second, the zero-success treatment is a code defect, not a mechanism result, and I confirmed this at the artifact level rather than taking the narrative for it: _build_action_template replaces the whole path value with the slot placeholder, its two branches are identical, and the prefix-stripping helper in the same module is never called. Every resource-B attempt therefore issued an invalid URL, which means the economic comparison was never posed. Third, and most consequential for how the next agent reads the numbers, the reported 13.67 amortized ratio is structurally invalid rather than merely large: the arm was charged one request per task on the success path while taking no cold fallback and achieving nothing, so the fallback-consistent value is infinite, and the cold baseline it is divided by is a fixed 3-request harness policy rather than an executed measurement. I also decline the audit's more generous durability reading. The capability is genuinely in the tree at this commit, which is new and worth recording, but the audit's claim that it 'survives the promotion gate' is not supported: the gate returned REVISE, the pre-declared rule forces promote_to_product=false, and product-promote.yml line 74 independently requires audit status PASS. The delta will be reverted by revert_product_reject.py, so this is the fourteenth cycle of the pathology the packet was commissioned to end, and the honest finding is that the pathology is structural -- the audited code delta and the reverted code delta are the same delta whenever a gate does not pass. I keep C-PARAM-INHERIT at its existing effective EXPERIMENTAL ceiling rather than downgrading it, because a defective arm is not evidence against inheritance and the previous EXP-GRAPH-36118890504 precedent is directly on point. I record C-MEAS-VALID as a retention event because the null control inducing 6 mechanisms from permuted labels is a real, bounded negative about control discrimination that the next designer must not rediscover. I set continue=false: the next step needs a changed kernel, a re-issued freeze and a Global Research Director mandate, and lane state is the workflow's to own.
